name: SEED-Bench_IT
description:
Dataset Card for SEED-Bench_IT
	


	
		
		Dataset description
	

This is a formatted version of SEED-Bench translated to the Italian language using MADLAD400.

	
		
		Citation
	

If you use this dataset in your research you should cite both of the following:
@inproceedings{musacchioLLaVANDiNO,
  title={LLaVA-NDiNO: Empowering LLMs with Multimodality for the Italian Language},
  author={Musacchio, Elio and Siciliani, Lucia and Basile, Pierpaolo and Semeraro, Giovanni}… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/swap-uniba/SEED-Bench_IT.
reputation: Translated variant of SEED-Bench for Italian; useful for benchmarking Italian multimodal LLM capabilities but has modest community uptake compared to original English resources.
